COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
17.02.2026 Recall Application (MCRC No. 1 of 2025)
In
WPCRL No. 1337 of 2024
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
The present Recall Application
(MCRC No.1 of 2025) has been filed to
recall the order dated 10.02.2025,
passed in Criminal Writ Petition No. 1337
of 2024.
2. Heard Mr. Tapan Singh, learned
counsel for the applicant-petitioner and
Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, learned Assistant
Government Advocate for the State.
3. Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate,
submitted on instructions that the
charge-sheet has already been filed,
therefore, the applicant-petitioner does
not want to press the present Recall
Application (MCRC No. 1 of 2025).
4. The present Recall Application
(MCRC No. 1 of 2025) is dismissed as
not pressed.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
17.02.2026
